description: Château de Coppet is the classical U-shaped house above the town of Coppet, with a French south façade and two pavilions set in an English park near Lake Geneva. The medieval fortress survives only as the older wing inside that classical front. It is not a lakeside military square like Morges or Rolle. The Open-Meteo model is heavily clouded and warm, with no rain.
